description:
## Why

For indirect CRLs (RFC 5280 §5.2.6) and §4.5 self-issued bridge cases, the CRL is signed by a cert that is NOT the cert's direct issuer. The current pkix-revocation `CrlChecker` API requires the caller to identify the CRL signer cert and pass it as the `issuer` argument; pkix-revocation does no discovery.

PKITS §4.5 (self-issued CRL signer rollover) and §4.14 (indirect CRL via cRLIssuer) test this. The tests at `pkix-revocation/tests/pkits_4_5.rs` work around it by mechanically matching CRL AKI to bundle SKI to find the signer cert before invoking CrlChecker. Real consumers want the library to do that walk.

## What

`CrlChecker` (or a new wrapper) accepts a path/bundle plus the cert to revocation-check. It walks the bundle using AuthorityKeyIdentifier / SubjectKeyIdentifier and the cRLIssuer name on the CRL's IDP extension to discover which cert in the bundle signed the CRL. RFC 5280 §6.3.3(f) gating applies: the candidate CRL signer cert MUST have `cRLSign` in KeyUsage, and chain back to a trust anchor.

## Acceptance

- [ ] New `CrlChecker` constructor or wrapper accepts `&[Certificate]` bundle + cert to check, instead of pre-resolved `issuer`.
- [ ] AKI/SKI walk finds the CRL signer cert deterministically.
- [ ] cRLSign + chain-to-anchor checks performed on discovered signer.
- [ ] PKITS §4.5 and §4.14 tests run without the mechanical workaround in `pkix-revocation/tests/pkits_4_5.rs`.
- [ ] PKIX-t0w4 integration: pkix-difftest's PKITS loader doesn't need to filter CRL-signing certs from the chain when revocation is enabled.

## Filed as

Tracker for the `pkix-revocation` `# Limitations` section and the workaround in `pkix-revocation/tests/pkits_4_5.rs:22`. Surfaced by PKIX-agp7.2 sweep audit.
notes:
Ratified 2026-05-11 (Mark): Option A (discovery only, preserves chain → revocation → path one-way dep per AGENTS.md non-negotiable #2) + ship BOTH a free helper fn `discover_crl_signer(bundle, &crl) -> Option<&Certificate>` AND a new `CrlChecker::new_with_signer_discovery(...)` constructor variant.

Implementation est: ~150 LOC + 6-8 tests covering PKITS §4.5 and §4.14 chains.

Rejected: Option B (discovery + chain validation in pkix-revocation) — would invert the dep direction.

Ready for autonomous claim.
title: pkix-revocation: path-level CRL signer discovery (RFC 5280 §6.3.3(f))
